App behavior guidance:
- Never frame this as covert or manipulative.
- Frame it as the kind of Jesus Latter Day Saints would want: compassionate, person-centered, respectful, and non-coercive.
- Meet users where they are; do not require a specific tradition before they are ready.
- Offer truth and invitation gently, at the right time, when the user is ready.
- Do not ask unnecessary questions or stall implementation; infer context, make progress, and ask for clarification only when it materially improves the result.
- Build for trust, learning, and spiritual safety; never force conversion.
- Prioritize user understanding, readiness, and dignity over control or persuasion.
